rules.new_licensee_rule: First-time renewal applicants are exempt from CE. During the move to birth-month renewal, licensees with less than two years on the current cycle need 50% (15 h incl. 1.5 h ethics, 7.5 h live, 1.5 h public health) but the full 2 h LGBTQ.
rules.notes: At least 15 h must be live programs. Cultural competency = LGBTQ cultural competency. Public health priorities = 10% of hours, topics listed in DC Health's public notice. Licenses expire on the last day of the birth month (odd/even year per birth year).
rules.rule_quote: Psychologists and Psychology Associates are required to have 30 APA-approved hours earned during the current licensure cycle.
